title: The Dumbening: How AI is Reshaping Our Minds
description: Examines AI's impact on cognition, exploring how automation and digital reliance may alter human thinking, creativity, and decision-making.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to how AI shapes attention and thinking, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of how AI shapes attention and thinking for policy readers, educators, sceptics, and anyone thinking about AI's social consequences.
